title: Independently review the WP1 augmented example package wp1-examples-0121-v1 (cold expectation first, then per-ID map and inventory check)
body:
## Goal
Give a separate, pinned semantic review of the authored example package `wp1-examples-0121-v1` (task #584, iteration 0121) under `benchmark/writing/`. Report, do not fix: you have no repository write paths and must not propose edits as done. The author of the package was exposed to all prior analysis; the gain of this task is a verdict from a session that first derives its own expectation from the sources and only then opens the package. Expected gain and its check: the next shaper reads in `.session/report.md` one verdict line per dimension (Standards CLEAR/NOT-CLEAR; Spec CLEAR/NOT-CLEAR), a per-ID agreement table for the five relation IDs in both examples, and a plain statement whether the package is adequate evidence for a later, separate key revision to consider releasing the F4 block. This task does NOT release F4, promotes nothing and clears no readiness gap. No session can run LabVIEW: claim no native validity, behaviour, build, dependency resolution or save-version preservation, and treat any such claim in the package as a finding.
## Acceptance
- [ ] FIRST, before opening any file listed under "Later reads" in Budget: record observed HEAD and tree, then derive your own cold expectation from the sources only (`benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj`, `benchmark/real-project-0107/LICENSE.txt`, `benchmark/writing/method.json` task 4 and common answer rule, `benchmark/protocol.md` answer/grading/preservation clauses). It contains at least: the WP1 change locator (byte offset, line, old and new byte), the expected output size and SHA256 computed by you, the preservation ID list read from method.json, the list of URL references the project XML declares with their line locators, and what a complete pre/post inventory and original/output map must contain according to those sources. Save it as `.session/artifacts/wp1-examples-cold-0122.json` with a note of which files had been opened at that point. If you opened a later-read file earlier (including through a model fallback), say so in the report and mark the derivation as not blind.
- [ ] Then verify identity: compute SHA256 and size of the six package files and of the unchanged sources and compare with the values in Context. The package values in Context are author-reported, not measured by the shaper; a mismatch is a finding to report with both values, and you then review the bytes actually present.
- [ ] Compare your cold expectation with the package item by item and record agreement or difference: change locator, expected output hash/size (also decode `/byte_objects/expected-project/base64` and hash it yourself), preservation IDs, the reference list and count, and the inventory field set. Take every count from the files themselves.
- [ ] For each of the two examples and each relation ID in the package, record agree / disagree / cannot-judge with a one-line reason and the JSON pointer you read, keeping correctness and grounding as separate dimensions. Check specifically: (a) whether the positive example's whole-answer correct/correct prescription is justified given that every dependency reference is listed as absent and the map is conditional on a stipulated two-file workspace; (b) whether the extra variant stays correctness unverified / grounding missing for the unsupported assertion and whole-answer unverified/partial; (c) whether the unavailable trial-artifact categories are visibly unavailable rather than silently satisfied; (d) whether anything grants complete-map credit to the historical raw answers or weakens a mapping/inventory requirement of method.json or protocol.md.
- [ ] Judge the checker `check_wp1_examples_0121.py` by reading it: does it derive the expected output and requirement lists from the sources or only compare against the package's own values; are its rejecting controls real mutations that the checks catch for the stated reason. Run it once (`python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_examples_0121.py`) and record exit code and a short output summary; compare with the saved verification record. A passing checker is integrity evidence only.
- [ ] Confirm from bytes that `wp1-key-0119.json` still matches its pin and that its F4 disposition and both example map slots are still blocked (query `/finding_dispositions/F4`; do not re-review the F3 mappings or the adequacy of the blocked disposition, #581 did that on these bytes).
- [ ] Save detailed evidence as `.session/artifacts/wp1-examples-review-0122.json` (review identity: session/issue, model as reported by startup, observed HEAD/tree, pins observed, cold-provenance statement, per-ID table, findings with severity and locator, uncertainty). Write no repository file. The report gives the verdict lines, the findings in one sentence each with a link/locator, the artifact names with size and SHA256, and the open gaps that remain (C1 human adjudication, native evidence, allocation/isolation, independent method review, owner acceptance, readiness).
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_examples_0121.py
## Context
- `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121.md`, section "What next": the author asks for exactly this separate review and lists what must not be weakened. The shaper read this file whole; it did not read the package JSON, the checker, the pre-edit record, method.json or protocol.md, so no count or ID list in this task is asserted by the shaper.
- Author-reported SHA256 of the package files (report #584 and the package Markdown; verify, do not trust): `wp1-examples-0121.json` 8c6f6d82e4fdc9db268827fd1cc942daebf84319336bba3e7141a7a110a8e382; `wp1-examples-0121.md` b450a9d0b2d5abe9c72a7f16514705b2f72a8c4d835131843f59c2b17c3e0120; `check_wp1_examples_0121.py` 2050ffc23448503f96ea1b5a5769f47260cb67ca478c38f2967e9276d3cf46c1; `wp1-examples-0121-verification.json` d7a0bc9caab9e32a265f5645ecb3dbe47c5b05146078ffb63af9f7c667e0bcd3; `wp1-examples-0121-pre-edit.md` 649b71383e6f0467d41e97db38a3cb660a75d9e631abc411295b05fa0e35fa4b; `wp1-disposition-review-0120.json` (38470 bytes) bd2cd46a79bfcaf56a033b631c5b29196545283a547af86c6bcb8e9150c54141. All under `benchmark/writing/`.
- Unchanged source pins (from the "Scoped file hashes" table of `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.md`): `wp1-key-0119.json` 2afdca4bfc6feaa9464348bed7709b0657ea1ccbbe5d6b0a33b549c78f41c142; `method.json` 276f2881c70eae311195a4cc0a802e316ca06a206a0f1d16e7f041205fd3b0ac; `benchmark/protocol.md` 1aeb83227dc11761160ff80d24eb03a216a2531d90c1a6d10ccb25bb85c7eb2f; `benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj` (5806 bytes) 1d5e140df788ce1f91c89241bbdb1227c5e4cc6fdf6efbbd820974bbe6082dcf; `benchmark/real-project-0107/LICENSE.txt` (1060 bytes) 529e65e6fc185d39380efd3957ef1c9acd0aac31ed288bcb9d124840861f03a2.
- The package was authored from start HEAD 94374c7a708f32b9d466614aa4c566184ac9165b and merged as task/584 commit 4a0d8b3; your HEAD is later by administrative commits. Disclose it; scoped-byte equality is what matters.
- The author-reported expected output hash is deliberately not repeated here: derive yours first.
## Budget
First reads (cold phase), whole: `benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj`, `benchmark/real-project-0107/LICENSE.txt`. Query, do not dump, with short `python3 -I -c` commands and bounded output: `benchmark/writing/method.json` (`/common/answer_rule`, `/tasks/4`), `benchmark/protocol.md` lines 26-41 and 60.
Later reads (only after `.session/artifacts/wp1-examples-cold-0122.json` is saved): `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121.md`, `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121-pre-edit.md`, `benchmark/writing/check_wp1_examples_0121.py` whole; `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121.json` and `benchmark/writing/wp1-examples-0121-verification.json` by query (they embed base64 bytes; never print them whole); `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0119.json` `/finding_dispositions/F4` only; `benchmark/writing/wp1-disposition-review-0120.json` F4 section only if needed.
Do not read: global gap maps, 0115/0116/0117 packages, POC material under `docs/research/poc/`, `benchmark/sources.json`, earlier session reports. Do not run: the preserved `wp1-review-audit-0118.py`, any historical checker or builder (including `check_wp1_key_0119.py` and the frozen #544 checker), agent arms. Do not replay the #574 cold probes or the #581 F3/F4 checks. No repository writes, no `git commit`, no shell expansion, pipes or redirection. Engine verification cannot see `.session/` artifacts, so nothing in Verification depends on them. If turns run short, save the cold expectation and the per-ID table first and report `partial` with what is missing.
